constitution.title: Конституция Российской Федерации (принята всенародным голосованием 12 декабря 1993 года, с изменениями, одобренными в ходе общероссийского голосования 1 июля 2020 года)
constitution.note: Current text as the President's site hosts it. Art. 3(3): referendum and free elections; art. 65(1): the 89 subjects listed (24 republics, 9 krais, 48 oblasts, 3 cities of federal significance, 1 autonomous oblast, 4 autonomous okrugs); art. 81(1): the President is elected for six years by direct vote; art. 95: the Federation Council of senators (two representatives per subject, one from its legislature and one from its executive, plus up to 30 presidential appointees) and the 450-member State Duma; art. 96(1): the Duma is elected for five years; arts. 130-131: local self-government by referendum, elections, and other forms of direct expression of will, in municipal formations whose kinds federal law sets.

fz67.title: Федеральный закон от 12 июня 2002 г. № 67-ФЗ «Об основных гарантиях избирательных прав и права на участие в референдуме граждан Российской Федерации»
fz67.note: Consolidated text as the President's site hosts it. Art. 10: elections of subject and municipal bodies fall on the single voting day, the second Sunday of September of the year their term ends (the third Sunday when the second is next to a public holiday), and in a State Duma year on the Duma's voting day.

fz20.title: Федеральный закон от 22 февраля 2014 г. № 20-ФЗ «О выборах депутатов Государственной Думы Федерального Собрания Российской Федерации»
fz20.note: Art. 3: 225 deputies in single-member districts and 225 by federal party lists in one federal district in proportion to the votes; art. 5(2): the President calls the election 90-110 days ahead, and polling falls on the third Sunday of the month in which the Duma's constitutional term ends.

fz19.title: Федеральный закон от 10 января 2003 г. № 19-ФЗ «О выборах Президента Российской Федерации»
fz19.note: Consolidated text. Art. 5(2): the Federation Council calls the election 90-100 days ahead; polling falls on the second Sunday of the month of the previous general election; art. 5(7) (as amended by Law No. 103-ФЗ of 1 June 2017): a Sunday in a week with a public holiday moves to the next Sunday, so the March Sunday next to 8 March always moves to the third Sunday of March; arts. 76-77: over half of those who voted wins, else a runoff of the top two 21 days later.

fkz_referendum.title: Федеральный конституционный закон от 28 июня 2004 г. № 5-ФКЗ «О референдуме Российской Федерации»
fkz_referendum.note: The federal referendum: called by the President on the initiative of at least 2 million voters, or of a constitutional assembly; none has been held under it.

fz414.title: Федеральный закон от 21 декабря 2021 г. № 414-ФЗ «Об общих принципах организации публичной власти в субъектах Российской Федерации»
fz414.note: Art. 9(11): the deputies of a subject's legislature serve five years; art. 15(5): a subject law may set how many deputies are elected by party lists in a single district in proportion to the votes; art. 20(2): the head of a subject is elected by the citizens or by the deputies of the subject's legislature, for five years; art. 22: direct election; art. 23: election by the legislature from candidates the President presents on the proposals of parliamentary parties.

fz33.title: Федеральный закон от 20 марта 2025 г. № 33-ФЗ «Об общих принципах организации местного самоуправления в единой системе публичной власти»
fz33.note: In force 90 days after publication (art. 94). Art. 9(2): urban okrugs, municipal okrugs, and intra-city municipal formations of the cities of federal significance; art. 89: where a subject keeps the two-level system, municipal districts with urban and rural settlements; art. 15(1): the representative body consists of deputies elected at municipal elections; art. 19(2): the head is elected at municipal elections, or by the representative body from its own members, from candidates of the subject's head, or from candidates of a competition commission; art. 43: local referendum; art. 44: municipal elections; art. 45: the assembly of citizens (сход); art. 91(4): on a subject's move to one level no new settlement or district elections are called except by-elections; art. 93(1)(1): chapters 1, 2, and 4-12 of Law No. 131-ФЗ of 6 October 2003, with its recall and boundary votes, lapse.

classes.name_en: Presidential elections by direct vote
classes.finest_note: The CEC publishes results by subject, territorial commission (ТИК), and precinct commission (УИК) on izbirkom.ru
classes.note: Direct election (Constitution art. 81(1)): six-year terms since the 2012 election (Law No. 6-ФКЗ of 30 December 2008), four years before. Over half of those who voted wins, else a runoff of the top two (Law No. 19-ФЗ arts. 76-77); the only runoff was on 3 July 1996. The 12 June 1991 election chose the President of the RSFSR with a Vice-President on the same ticket. Elections: 12 June 1991, 16 June and 3 July 1996, 26 March 2000 (early), 14 March 2004, 2 March 2008, 4 March 2012, 18 March 2018, and 17 March 2024 (polling 15-17 March).

cadence.vacancy_rule: The Federation Council calls an early election within 14 days of the vacancy, held on the last Sunday before three months have passed (art. 5(4)).

classes.disposition_reason: No popular vote counts by candidate exist at the guberniya level, and no body today publishes the curial returns; they survive only in printed imperial statistics.

classes.name: Выборы высших должностных лиц субъектов Российской Федерации
classes.name_en: Direct elections of the heads of subjects (governors and republic heads)
classes.note: Direct elections from 1991-1996 until Law No. 159-ФЗ of 11 December 2004 replaced them with confirmation by the legislature on the President's nomination; restored by Law No. 40-ФЗ of 2 May 2012 with first elections on 14 October 2012. Five-year terms (Law No. 414-ФЗ art. 20(2)), a majority with a runoff of the top two, and polling on the single voting day; early elections follow a resignation, usually after an acting head is appointed. Some republics elect the head through the legislature instead (regional_head_indirect).

cadence.locator: http://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/47393 (art. 20(2): "на пять лет"); Law No. 67-ФЗ art. 10: the single voting day

cadence.administered_by: Election commission of the subject of the Russian Federation
cadence.vacancy_rule: The President appoints an acting head until an early election on the next single voting day.

classes.note: From 2005 to 2012 legislatures confirmed the President's nominee; since 2013 a subject may choose election by its legislature from three candidates the President presents on the proposals of parliamentary parties (Law No. 414-ФЗ art. 23), as several North Caucasus republics and autonomous okrugs do.

classes.name: Выборы депутатов законодательных органов субъектов Российской Федерации
classes.name_en: Legislatures of the subjects (regional dumas, assemblies, and state councils), general elections
classes.note: Each subject's legislature, including the Moscow City Duma and the Legislative Assembly of Saint Petersburg, is elected for five years (Law No. 414-ФЗ art. 9(11)), mostly in a mixed system of single- or multi-member districts and a regional party list in one district (art. 15(5)). First elected from December 1993 to 1995 after the Supreme Soviets of the republics and the regional soviets were dissolved; polling on the single voting day since 2013.

cadence.vacancy_rule: A list seat passes to the next candidate on the list; a district seat is filled at a by-election.

classes.name: Выборы на оккупированных территориях Украины
classes.name_en: Elections Russia holds in occupied Ukrainian territory (Crimea and Sevastopol since 2014; Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson oblasts since 2022)
classes.note: Russia runs federal, regional, and municipal elections and the 2014 and 2022 annexation votes in these territories and counts them in its national totals, including Duma single-member districts and the presidential vote.
classes.disposition_reason: Held on Ukrainian territory outside Ukrainian law; the archive places these territories under Ukraine and does not record Russia's votes there as Russian subnational elections.

classes.name: Выборы депутатов представительных органов городских и муниципальных округов и внутригородских муниципальных образований
classes.name_en: Councils of urban okrugs, municipal okrugs, and the intra-city municipalities of Moscow and Saint Petersburg (and the intra-city districts of 2014-2025)
classes.note: Representative bodies of deputies elected at municipal elections (Law No. 33-ФЗ arts. 15(1) and 44) for a term the charter sets, by single- or multi-member districts, or mixed with party lists in larger bodies (art. 44(7)-(8)); polling on the single voting day. Single-level okrugs are absorbing districts and settlements as subjects move to one level (art. 91).

classes.note: The most numerous elected bodies, created by Law No. 131-ФЗ from 2005-2006, mostly by plurality in multi-member districts; disappearing as subjects merge districts and settlements into okrugs (Law No. 33-ФЗ art. 91).

classes.note: A head elected at municipal elections is one of four options (Law No. 33-ФЗ art. 19(2)); most large cities now choose the head through the council, and direct elections survive mainly in settlements and some okrugs. Mayors of Moscow and Saint Petersburg are regional heads.

classes.note: The council elects the head from its members, from candidates of the subject's head, or from a competition commission's shortlist (Law No. 33-ФЗ art. 19(2)(2)-(4)).
classes.disposition_reason: Chosen by the council, not by voters.

classes.note: Called by the council on the initiative of citizens, associations, or the council and administration together, over the whole municipality (Law No. 33-ФЗ art. 43); most are votes on self-taxation in rural settlements.

classes.name_en: Municipal recall votes and votes on boundary changes and transformations (Law No. 131-ФЗ, abolished 2025)
classes.note: Law No. 131-ФЗ art. 24 provided votes on recalling a deputy or elected head and on changing a municipality's boundaries or merging it; its chapter 5 lapsed under Law No. 33-ФЗ art. 93(1)(1), which keeps no such vote.

classes.name: Сход граждан
classes.name_en: Assemblies of citizens (сход) in small settlements
classes.note: Decides self-taxation and supports initiative projects by a show of hands of the residents present (Law No. 33-ФЗ art. 45); under Law No. 131-ФЗ it also replaced the council in the smallest settlements.
classes.disposition_reason: An open meeting deciding by those present, with no ballot or published count by an election commission.

classes.name: Выборы в местные Советы народных депутатов РСФСР
classes.name_en: Local soviets of the RSFSR (to 1993)
classes.note: Krai, oblast, city, district, and village soviets, last elected in March 1990 and dissolved by decrees of October 1993.
classes.disposition_reason: Results were published only locally in the press of the day; no official digital publication exists.

classes.name: Судьи, мировые судьи и присяжные заседатели
classes.name_en: Judges, justices of the peace, and jurors
classes.note: Federal judges are appointed by the President, judges of the high courts by the Federation Council on the President's nomination (Constitution arts. 83 and 102), justices of the peace by the subject's legislature, and jurors are drawn by lot.
classes.disposition_reason: Judges are appointed or chosen by legislatures and jurors by lot; none faces voters.

classes.name: Предварительное голосование политических партий
classes.name_en: Party preliminary votes (primaries)
classes.note: Parties, chiefly United Russia since 2016, hold preliminary votes to rank candidates; no law requires them.
classes.disposition_reason: Run by the parties themselves under their own rules, not by an election commission.
